correctness.rationale: Exact Hardy model-space decomposition and Cauchy determinant yield the product of three squared pseudohyperbolic distances. An exact polynomial cross-product identity proves that reflecting the two equal-radius nodes around the direction opposite the third is globally optimal, without a local-only assumption. The resulting scalar logarithmic derivative has a strictly increasing side and a strictly decreasing side, guaranteeing one interior maximizer. The exact stationary equation yields the sharp quarter-power asymptotic for fixed s. CHECK.py passed 15,729 finite checks, including exact rational factorizations; the continuous theorem relies on the written proof, not finite sampling.

value.rationale: The first natural non-equiradial three-generator D-optimal Hardy orbit design has a complete global optimizer, a unique scalar equation valid across all positive mixed radii, and a sharp quarter-power angular coalescence when the equal radii approach the boundary. This distinguishes determinant stability from geometric separation and extends the common-circle regular-polygon analysis in a quantitatively nontrivial way.
